caption: The drawing depicts six metal objects arranged symmetrically on a beige or light tan background. Three of these objects, located in the upper part of the drawing, are thin, elongated, and have small rounded heads, while the three objects in the lower part are thicker, taper to a sharp point, and have hexagonal heads. The central thick object and two thinner objects on either side are significantly larger than the others and are labeled “THREE TIME ENLARGEMENT.” Below these enlarged versions are smaller representations of the same objects with the label “EXACT SIZE.” The thinner objects are on the left and right sides, while the thicker, hex-head objects are positioned in the center. The drawing is rendered in grayscale, showing detailed shading to indicate the metallic surface and three-dimensional form of the objects. The name "HARRY G. ABERDEEN" is printed in the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Nails and Pins
